# fomc-research

> An open FOMC research database maintained by Elendil Labs: the Federal Reserve's
> primary-source corpus (statements, minutes, SEP, press-conference transcripts,
> speeches, testimony, 2018 to present), the Fed's stated policy regime parsed from its
> own statements, a per-meeting SPY/TLT "event truth" table, and a weighted
> regime-intelligence read of news, balance-sheet and market-pricing evidence. Read-only
> tools are exposed to agents through an MCP server. Historical and observational
> evidence only; not investment advice.

Code is licensed PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0; data is CC BY 4.0
(attribution: "FOMC Research database © 2026 Elendil Labs, CC BY 4.0,
https://github.com/Elendil-Labs/fomc-research").

- [README](README.md): what the repo is, quick start, data catalog, CLI, MCP config

## Data (fetch raw, no clone needed)

Base URL: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elendil-Labs/fomc-research/main/

- apps/fomc-dashboard/public/data/fomc_event_truth.json: per-meeting truth table (date, chair, stated regime, action, target range, SPY/TLT returns d0, +1, +2, +3, +5, +10)
- apps/fomc-dashboard/public/data/regime_intel/latest.json: current regime read, bucket scores, scored sources, checklist
- apps/fomc-dashboard/public/data/regime_intel/balance_sheet.json: deterministic FRED balance-sheet axis
- apps/fomc-dashboard/public/data/regime_intel/market_pricing_axis.json: deterministic FRED market-pricing axis
- apps/fomc-dashboard/public/data/regime_intel/history.json: daily net-lean log
- data/fomc/analysis/regime_timeline.csv: statement-parsed hiking/easing regime timeline
- data/fomc/statement/text/, minutes/text/, sep/text/, press_conference_transcript/text/, speech/text/, testimony/text/: the corpus as plain text
- data/fomc/manifest.json: index of every corpus document with source URL and sha256

Freshness: check `generated_at` in latest.json and the last row of the truth table. The
data is only as current as the last refresh commit.

## Tools

- MCP server `fomc-intel` (packages/fomc-server): 16 read-only and pipeline tools over stdio or HTTP; see README "MCP server"
- CLI `fomc` (packages/fomc): status, regime, truth, study, dips, backtest, fetch, speeches, warsh, export-truth
